title: Remediate transitive Snyk findings via parent dependency upgrades

comments.text: Started remediation task. Detected pre-existing/unexpected local changes in poetry.lock and project/events during initial status check; pausing to confirm with user before proceeding per workspace safety policy.

comments.text: Validated remediation in lockfile: gitpython 3.1.50, urllib3 2.7.0, idna 3.17. Verified dependency parent paths remain via python-semantic-release, botocore/requests/modelscope, and requests/httpx/anyio/yarl. Local snyk test for poetry lock now reports pypdf only for Python project.
